headline: Malcolm Spellman Teases The Drop Future
post:
Hey everyone! If you have been keeping up with the FX series The Drop, the creator has some big plans ahead. According to The Hollywood Reporter, showrunner Malcolm Spellman recently discussed his multi-season vision for the Snowfall spinoff. 

During the first-season finale, characters like Wanda and Lamar faced some difficult hurdles. Record executives reportedly tried to exploit a tragic death for publicity. Spellman explained that this storyline was just a glimpse of what is ahead. He noted that upcoming seasons will explore how the music industry allegedly manipulated culture during that era. 

Updates will follow as more news becomes available.

#TheDrop #Snowfall #MalcolmSpellman
original_title: ‘Snowfall’ Spinoff Boss Malcolm Spellman Lays Out Multi-Season Plan for ‘The Drop,’ Why Season One Was Just a “Dash of What’s Coming”

headline: Spider-Man joins Avengers: Armageddon lineup
post:
November 2026 brings massive storylines to comic book readers, according to Screen Rant. The new Avengers roster in Marvel's Armageddon includes Spider-Man, Wolverine, Daredevil, Luke Cage, Captain Marvel, and Miracleman. Following the events of the storyline, S.H.I.E.L.D. is secretly funded by the United Nations and Captain America has woken from his coma.

Elsewhere in the comic book world, Spider-Man faces the Infernal Hulk, also known as the Eldest. While the Eldest has already defeated Wolverine and claimed other heroes for a monstrous army, Peter Parker may not be ready for the upcoming fight.
